req.title: Basic-auth handles special characters
req.statement: The system shall URL-decode <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing against the supplied Basic credentials.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must URL-decode path segments before comparing against Basic credentials. I need to test: (1) positive case with URL-encoded special chars in path that match decoded credentials, (2) negative case where credentials don't match the URL-decoded path values, (3) boundary case with minimally encoded chars (e.g., space as %20), (4) decision-table case covering both user and passwd mismatch independently, (5) negative path with wrong password but correct user. Each test uses exact status code assertions and exact JSON body assertions to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_url_encoded_special_chars_positive
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Client sends Basic credentials matching the URL-decoded path segments
actions: Import httpbin.core app and create test client
URL-encode special characters in user and passwd path segments (e.g., 'us%40er' for 'us@er')
Send GET /basic-auth/us%40er/p%40ss with Authorization: Basic base64('us@er:p@ss')
trace: R-HTTPBIN-041: URL-decode path segments before comparing credentials
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

user = 'us@er'
passwd = 'p@ss'
creds = base64.b64encode(f'{user}:{passwd}'.encode()).decode()
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

r = client.get('/basic-auth/us%40er/p%40ss', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'us@er'

tests.name: test_basic_auth_encoded_path_unencoded_credentials_mismatch
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Path has encoded chars but credentials supply the raw percent-encoded string (not decoded)
actions: Import httpbin.core app and create test client
Send GET /basic-auth/us%40er/p%40ss with credentials 'us%40er:p%40ss' (literal percent signs)
expected: HTTP 401 response (credentials are literal percent-encoded, not decoded)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-041: supplying literal percent-encoded string as credential must fail because path decodes to 'us@er'
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

# Credentials use literal percent-encoded strings, NOT the decoded values
raw_user = 'us%40er'
raw_passwd = 'p%40ss'
creds = base64.b64encode(f'{raw_user}:{raw_passwd}'.encode()).decode()
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

r = client.get('/basic-auth/us%40er/p%40ss', headers=headers)
# Path decodes to 'us@er'/'p@ss', but credentials are 'us%40er'/'p%40ss' -> mismatch
assert r.status_code == 401
